title: docs(spec): the email template locale docs describe the ladder #28880 landed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9T4EekKNS3mPkuvkK2fCJrT)_

Fixes #28896

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：spec 里讲邮件模板 locale 解析的说明文字（`SendTemplateInput` 两段注释、`email-template.zod.ts` 的常量与 `locale` 注释及对外 JSON schema 的 describe、`defineStack` 缺 `en-US` 行时的提醒文字）改成 #28880 落地后的真实规则；只改文字，不改 schema、不改提醒何时触发。
- 为什么改：#28880 之后内置模板加载器会按 BCP-47 折叠（`en-GB`→`en`、`zh-TW`→`zh-CN`），再试栈声明的 fallback，再试 `en-US`；旧文字还说“精确匹配、只重试 `en-US`、不折叠”，作者照着写会做错判断。
- 风险与回滚：只有注释、describe 和一条 `console.warn` 文案，运行行为不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/email-template.zod.ts`（describe 是对外发布的文字）、`packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`（`SendTemplateInput.locale` 是唯一完整写出两条阶梯的地方）、`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`（提醒文案）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-email-template-locale-floor.test.ts`，预期全绿（现有钉住这段文字的断言都还成立）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（落地前需一次契约复审档复核）。

## What changes

Text only. No schema shape, accept set, export or warning trigger changes. `en` and `en-US` stay two rows of one bundle; only how the resolver picks the row is described anew, as landed in #28917 (`e0dc0771ab`).

- **`packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`**: `SendTemplateInput.template` now says the name is matched exactly and every rung reads one row at one tag exactly. `SendTemplateInput.locale` carries both ladders as the code has them (`EmailService.resolveAndRenderTemplate`): a named locale over the built-in registry loader folds by `resolveBundleLocale` (exact, case-insensitive, base language, variant expansion, first match in ascending tag order), then the declared fallback (`II18nService.getFallbackLocale()`: `i18n.fallbackLocale`, else `defaultLocale`) folded the same way, then `en-US`, then `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`; a rung resolving to a tag already tried is skipped; a replacement `TemplateLoader` keeps the exact ladder; a no-locale call keeps `en-US` then the lowest tag. The two `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` error lines (`sendTemplate`, `renderTemplate`) no longer say `(name, locale|en-US)`.
- **`packages/spec/src/system/email-template.zod.ts`**: the `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_FLOOR_LOCALE` docblock (the floor is now the rung that depends on neither the fold nor the declared fallback), the `locale` docblock, and the `locale` `.describe()` served in the JSON schema.
- **`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`** (bounded in-place fix, same stale-ladder class, not in the card's list): `warnEmailTemplateLocaleFloor`'s docblock and its `console.warn` text said "matches exactly and retries only `en-US` — there is no language-subtag folding". The text now describes the fold, the declared fallback and the exact ladder a replacement loader keeps. Which bundles it fires on is unchanged (see Acceptance notes).
- **`packages/spec/src/stack-email-template-locale-floor.test.ts`**: the file's header comment only (it stated the old ladder in the present tense). No assertion changed.
- Regenerated `content/docs/references/system/email-template.mdx` (the `locale` row) and a spec `patch` changeset.

## Tests

Forced test edits: none. Every existing pin on this wording still holds (`'en-US'`, `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`, `/NAMES a locale/`, `/lowest locale tag/` in the describe; `'no fallback floor'`, `"none tagged 'en-US'"`, `"carries rows for 'en-GB'"` in the warning).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (under `os-verify-lock`): Test Files 789 passed (789), Tests 23325 passed | 1 todo.
- Consumer: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test` after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-email^...' build`: Test Files 47 passed (47), Tests 764 passed (764), `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This includes `template-locale-fold.test.ts` and `template-locale-resolution.test.ts`, which pin the ladder this text describes.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 1 of 14 stale (`check:docs`) before regeneration; `--fix` re-check `✓ check:docs`.
- The `repo` vitest project (`email-template-floor-locale-parity.pin.test.ts`) is CI's (`Test Core`); not run locally, the file is unchanged.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The floor warning now also fires on bundles the built-in loader serves.** `THE_TRAP` in the floor test (`defaultLocale: 'en'`, `fallbackLocale: 'en'`, an `en` row, no `en-US` row) reaches every recipient over the built-in loader on a host whose i18n service answers that fallback, yet still warns. The warning still names a real gap (a replacement `TemplateLoader`, or a host that declares no fallback), and its text now says so. Whether its trigger should change is a behaviour question on an authoring diagnostic, left to the seat.
- **Text outside `packages/spec` that still states the exact ladder** (not touched here): `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` L217–233 (hand-written docs); `packages/metadata-core/src/item-key-discriminators.ts` L13–19 (a code docblock citing the old ladder); `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` L957 (a checklist clause asserting "EXACT match with no language-subtag folding").
- Card vs code: they agree. One detail the card did not state: a replacement `TemplateLoader` gets neither the fold nor the declared fallback rung (pinned in `template-locale-fold.test.ts`), and the text says so.
